# Course Calendar

This calendar summarizes the upcoming online courses in the **Methods in Health Data Science with R** training pathway.

All courses are delivered online on:

- Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
- 17:00-19:00, Morocco time
- 20 participants maximum per cohort

Final registration opens 10 days before the start of each course and is confirmed after payment.

## Upcoming Courses

| Course | Format | Schedule | Price | Seats |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Applied Biostatistics with R | Online | Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 17:00-19:00 | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Machine Learning with R | Online | Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 17:00-19:00 | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R | Online | Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 17:00-19:00 | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Meta-Analysis with R | Online | Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 17:00-19:00 | 1500 DH | 20 |
